study type: Population-level health service study, Retrospective cohort study
exposure: Patients hospitalized for STEMI/AMI, hip fracture, cholecystitis, and women giving birth
outcome: Surgery within 48 hours of admission for hip fracture
cohort: Residents of the Veneto Region (Italy) hospitalized for STEMI, AMI, hip fracture, or cholecystitis, and women giving birth, discharged between January 2012 and December 2012.
finding: Several hospital care process quality indicators were associated with disparities related to social determinants, such as age, gender, education, and citizenship.
mod_finding: Women with lower socioeconomic status were more likely to undergo cesarean section.
